summary: Mineral County lookout site near Superior with a 1935 crow's nest and tent cabin, listed as abandoned; no later description found.

facts.agency: Lolo National Forest (named on the firelookout.com page; role not stated)
facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned; no source describes what remains at the site today

events.note: Page dates the crow's nest and tent cabin to 1935

evidence.supports: about nine miles south of Superior
agency named as Lolo National Forest
crow's nest and tent cabin dated 1935; abandoned
list places site under Lookout Sites / Non-lookout Structures
Montana list: crowsnest type, abandoned, coordinates

notes_for_editor: Only the firelookout.com page and the FFLA Montana list support this story. Record status 'gone' comes from our index tag 'Not on standing map', not from the page, which says only 'Abandoned'; please confirm. Record kind 'platform' fits a crow's nest, but the page calls the site a crow's nest and tent cabin, so check the kind. Two web searches found no other Montana Sunrise Point. A 2017 wildfire called Sunrise burned in the Lolo National Forest near Superior, but no source ties it to this lookout, so it is not used.
